stills.title: Mystic Figure with Giant Eye
stills.description: A green-skinned figure in a purple robe and headpiece stands on a stone path holding a small red mouse. The figure has one large pink eye and stands under a giant pink eye in the sky while pink flowers float around a colorful cosmic background.

stills.title: Man at Anvil with Runes
stills.description: A person with short gray hair and a halo sits centered facing forward with a serious face and both hands resting on a dark anvil. The setting is inside a brick structure with arched openings showing a starry night sky while glowing ghostly shirts float around the figure with marks and paint on them and ropes hang from the anvil.

stills.title: Horned Figure with Scroll
stills.description: A black horned figure with pink drips on its face sits on swirling green cloth against a black background. The figure holds an open green scroll with paint writing while three glowing orbs float nearby showing silhouettes of people and night scenes with a moon.

stills.title: Horned Figure by the Lake
stills.description: A black horned silhouette with pink tears sits on a rock in dark water, one hand touching a flowering tree branch with yellow blossoms. The scene shows a pink swirling sky with blue eyes, broken black shapes above, glowing blue orbs containing couples, golden fish, green plants, and tall dark stones with painted marks, all reflected in the calm water.

stills.title: Mystic Loom Workshop
stills.description: A person sees a hooded figure standing at a wooden table inside a stone room with arched windows. The figure's hands touch a white t-shirt and glowing threads on a large loom that holds a long fabric covered in painted marks and runes while an open book, tools, and a lit candle sit on the table in front.

stills.title: Horned Figure by Ruins
stills.description: A black silhouette of a horned female figure sits on a stone altar draped in green cloth. Her face shows glowing pink eyes and long flowing pink tears while one hand touches a flowering branch and the other rests on the stone.

stills.title: Demon Reading
stills.description: A black demon with horns and a long tail sits on a green table covered by a cloth. The demon looks up at three floating picture frames that show silhouettes of people under flowering branches while its hand rests on an open book with paint marks on the cover.

stills.title: Horned Figure with Cherry Tree
stills.description: A horned female figure with a starry dark blue body sits on a large green tree stump. Her right hand holds a bubble showing two silhouetted people under a moon while pink liquid drips from her fingers onto the stump and into a dark pool below.

stills.title: Horned Figure by Mystic Tree
stills.description: A person sees a horned black silhouette figure standing in water with glowing blue patterns on its body and long flowing hair. The figure's hands reach toward a large twisted green tree covered in yellow flowers while holding a sheet of music that drips black paint into the reflective water below.

stills.title: Surreal Skull Music Scene
stills.description: A large cracked green skull wearing red glasses sits in a broken purple room with rain falling from a stormy sky visible through the ceiling. A hairless cat with glasses writes on sheet music in the skull's mouth, while a blue-haired armored woman with a glowing staff floats nearby, two skeleton figures in black robes play saxophone and hold papers on a red spiral rug, and small skeletons emerge from potion bottles as musical notes float through the air.

stills.title: Skull Band with Wizard Cat
stills.description: A large green skull wearing sunglasses sits in the center on a wooden floor with its mouth open. A wizard cat with glasses stands on the skull holding a glowing staff while two skeleton musicians play a saxophone and drum beside it.

stills.title: Skeleton Ballet
stills.description: A green skull with red sunglasses sits on a stage and watches a hairless cat in a pink tutu dance on a stool while holding up a book titled DESPAIR and a red feather. Skeletons in ballet skirts play music and dance around a snowy floor covered in papers and feathers as purple smoke and musical notes float through the air.

stills.title: Enchanted Ballet Stage
stills.description: A ballerina in a pink tutu dances on one leg while a man in armor holds her waist and a ghostly blue figure projects light from a large movie camera. In the foreground an open book labeled DESPAIR lies on the floor with a sword through it next to a second fallen ballerina and scattered film reels. The scene is a dark theatrical stage with heavy curtains icicles and colored stage lights.

stills.title: Psychedelic Forest Ritual
stills.description: A blue-skinned woman in a pink tutu floats upside down in the air with one leg extended high while another identical woman lies on the snowy ground below. A knight in green armor kneels in the snow holding open a large glowing book that emits purple smoke and colorful drips as two bandaged mummies stand among the trees watching.

stills.title: Cosmic Ballet Dancers
stills.description: Three blue-skinned ballerinas perform a dramatic lift and pose in a swirling cosmic setting. Their colorful tutus and bodies drip with bright paint as glowing stars and leaves float around them against a dark starry sky with lightning.

stills.title: Dancing Ballerinas in Space
stills.description: A person sees two ballerinas dancing together in the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. One ballerina in a green dress stands on one leg holding a broom that shoots sparks while the other in a pink dress does a split on a colorful tiled floor with a small green dragon beside her holding a glowing orb.

stills.title: Fantasy Clockwork Vortex
stills.description: A large skeletal dragon wearing a purple hooded cloak flies through a swirling vortex of time and magic with its mouth open and orange tongue out. Below it a green and blue flying elephant with wings holds a purple orb while a witch on a broomstick flies nearby and a green beetle carries a large clock as multiple hot air balloons shaped like clocks float in the background.

stills.title: Skeleton on Pier
stills.description: A skeleton in a purple hooded robe stands on a wooden pier over water. The skeleton holds a red dripping gun in one hand and an alarm clock in the other while red paint runs down the pier.

stills.title: Surreal Desert Eye Scene
stills.description: A woman in a red robe and headscarf walks barefoot across sand dunes with small cacti around her. Above her floats a giant eye with a red mouse inside its pupil, a green vine, and another red mouse standing on a red and yellow sphere, all surrounded by transparent bubbles containing small desert scenes.

stills.title: Desert Bubble Dream
stills.description: A large red mouse in a purple robe stands on a sand dune and blows bubbles from a small wand held in its hand. Above float many iridescent bubbles containing tiny desert scenes with cacti, smaller mice, and robed figures while a glowing red eye watches from the sky over a colorful geometric dome that leaks liquid onto the sand.

stills.title: Mosaic Woman Portrait
stills.description: A woman with a green and blue mosaic face has her mouth open as if shouting. Her hair flows out in colorful swirls filled with white horses, flowers, and vines while a dog in a ruff collar stands on a ledge to the right and looks at floating orbs that contain faces.

stills.title: ethereal woman with dog
stills.description: A woman with pale skin, blue eyes, and mosaic patterns on her face looks upward from the center of the image. Her hands are not visible touching anything while a grey dog in a ruffled collar and armor stands beside her on a cracked reflective surface that shows their reflections below.

stills.title: Hooded Figure with Candles
stills.description: A hooded figure in a long black robe stands barefoot on a dark platform covered in glowing marks and water. The figure has no visible face and holds hands out toward three lit candles floating in the air while three dark birds fly around with glowing ribbons and three pale hands rise from below holding small houses and figures.

stills.title: Mystic Sorceress with Birds and Flowers
stills.description: A woman in a dark hooded robe stands with arms outstretched, her face pale with a neutral expression. Her hands are open with one releasing glowing particles and the other near floating marks and runes, while birds fly around her, flowers grow from the cracked dark ground, and two glowing orbs with small scenes sit on either side. The setting shows ruined stone towers under a dramatic sky filled with colorful swirling clouds, a large eye symbol, and a cracked full moon.

stills.title: Fat Armored Warrior
stills.description: A very large and obese man with a bare tattooed torso sits on a stone throne wearing black metal armor and a book on his head. His gloved hands rest on an open book on one side and an anvil on the other while papers and candles surround him in a fiery purple setting.

stills.title: Armored Figure with Scales
stills.description: A heavy person in black metal armor sits on a dark stone platform with eyes closed. The right hand holds a white feather pen and writes in an open book resting on the lap while the left hand rests on a large decorated shield and the feet stand on another burning book.

stills.title: Mystical Tree of Life
stills.description: A person sees a huge gnarled tree with a round bulbous trunk covered in golden paint marks and branches holding colorful stained glass leaves. The tree grows from a starry reflective pool at the bottom where a white robed figure with flowing cloth touches a circular pattern on the water surface, two hands reach from the sides toward the tree, waterfalls flow from the branches, and a glowing castle sits at the very top under a starry sky with aurora lights.

stills.title: Mysterious Cloaked Figure
stills.description: A cloaked figure with a pale face floats above a circular pool of water with glowing patterns on its surface. The figure's hands reach down toward the pool while a giant gnarled tree with paint on its bark stretches across the starry sky with waterfalls flowing from its branches.

stills.title: 1000-Pound Stasis Diver
stills.description: A large heavyset woman with gray hair floats in the air above a round celestial pool. Her face looks focused, her hands reach down toward the glowing water where her own reflection lies at the bottom, and water falls from a giant tree above her.

stills.title: Floating Figure in Cosmic Scene
stills.description: A woman with closed eyes floats upside down in the center of the image, wearing a shiny green and gold patterned bodysuit and a black head covering with a white flower design. Her arms are outstretched with hands open, not touching anything, above a glowing circular pool on broken rocky ground that has waterfalls flowing down into darkness, with twisted bare trees on both sides and colorful aurora lights filling the space.

stills.title: Diving Figure
stills.description: A heavy woman with light skin and purple patterned clothes stands barefoot on the edge of a diving board above dark water. Her hands reach forward and her face looks down toward her large black shadow that spreads across the glowing pond below.

stills.title: Woman on Diving Board
stills.description: A heavy woman in a purple swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a high diving board with one hand on the board and the other on the railing. Below her is an indoor pool with glowing blue, green, and purple swirling patterns and a dark silhouette at the center, set in a tiled room with a purple skylight above.

stills.title: Man Jumping into Pool
stills.description: A large heavy man with a black swim cap is captured mid-air as he jumps into a swimming pool with arms outstretched and a smile on his face. His hands are not touching anything, the setting is an outdoor pool area at dusk with a diving board above, colorful pool noodles floating in the glowing turquoise water, and a single purple swim fin visible underwater near his reflection.

stills.title: Woman Jumping into Pool
stills.description: A heavy woman with wet curly dark hair is captured mid-air as she jumps feet-first into a swimming pool, creating a big splash and colorful ripples. Her eyes are closed and mouth smiling, she wears a purple one-piece swimsuit with gold patterns, one hand touches the diving board while the other is outstretched, in an old indoor pool with painted walls.

stills.title: Couple Jumping in Pool
stills.description: A large man and a large woman are jumping into a swimming pool at night holding hands. Their reflections are visible in the glowing turquoise water below along with floating pool toys while steam rises around them.

stills.title: Two Women at Pool
stills.description: A light-skinned heavy woman wearing a crown and black swim bottoms is jumping into a pool with her mouth open and one hand raised while a dark-skinned heavy woman in a purple swimsuit stands on the edge pointing at her. The setting is a pool area at dusk with a diving board, pink flamingo float, unicorn pool toy, and palm trees in the background.

stills.title: Chained Figure with Shield
stills.description: A dark-skinned man with golden eyes and a spiked crown kneels on the floor of a stone chamber. His hands touch the ground and a large shield that rests against his body while chains bind his arms and neck.

stills.title: Weaver in the Chapel
stills.description: A hooded figure sits at a large wooden loom inside a gothic stone room. The person's hands touch a paper with a flower design while a glowing fiery object flies toward the loom and an hourglass, broken crown, and spilled bucket sit on a table in front.

stills.title: Blacksmith Forging Blue Crystal
stills.description: A hooded blacksmith stands at an anvil holding a hammer in one hand while the other touches a paper with marks and drawings. With tongs in a large gloved hand a glowing blue crystal is held above the anvil as blue liquid drips from it and from a large circular device hanging above covered in painted marks and runes. The stone walls are covered in painted marks and runes with blue birds and feathers scattered around. The scene uses dark blues, glowing cyan, brown, and gray stone colors.

stills.title: Cosmic Melting Clock Cauldron
stills.description: A large cracked white and gold cauldron with gears and dripping substance floats in the center of a swirling cosmic scene. Below it three blue hooded figures with clock faces for heads reach upward with their hands while floating books, hourglasses, gears and vines drift around them against a dark starry background with beams of light and three colored moons above.

stills.title: Cosmic Forge Figure
stills.description: A cracked female figure with a white face and blue energy stands behind an anvil with blue light and sparks coming from it. Her right hand holds a key while her left hand touches blue energy and paint marks cover the stone walls around her.

stills.title: Demonic Organ
stills.description: A person sees a large pipe organ built into a broken arched stone window with a blue demon having horns and one eye appearing inside the glass. The demon's hands reach out from the glass as blue liquid drips down over the keyboard and onto an open book on the floor that shows the word STASIS.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Eye
stills.description: A large wooden cuckoo clock with a giant blue eye for a face sits at the top of the picture dripping blue liquid. Below it a blue scaled mouth pours more blue liquid into swirling water where two hands reach up one with a scaled sleeve and the other with dragon wings on the fingers both wearing rings and touching a large ornate key.

stills.title: Kneeling Demon Knight
stills.description: A demon knight in red armor with horns and glowing eyes kneels inside a ruined cathedral. His hands hold a hammer and touch an anvil with a glowing red sword blade, while large blue and red fiery wings spread behind him and an open book rests nearby.

stills.title: Ruined Goddess with Black Hole
stills.description: A stone statue of a bare-chested woman with glowing blue flames for eyes and hair sits inside a broken circular stone structure covered in green vines. Two large black birds fly near a massive black hole with a red fiery ring in a dark red sky while a third bird flies lower; broken stone pillars, scattered carved stones with paint marks, and glowing blue liquid appear in the foreground.

stills.title: Fallen Statue and Ravens
stills.description: A cracked stone statue of a person lies on the ground with glowing blue eyes and green vines wrapped around its body. Two large black ravens fly above it with blue symbols painted on their wings while a stone figure stands nearby with one hand raised near a glowing golden crystal on a pedestal.

stills.title: Blue and Red Demons
stills.description: A blue demon with horns kneels on the left and reaches with both hands to touch a glowing yellow crystal formation. A large red demon with a curved horn on its head kneels on the right and also touches the same crystals with its hands while more yellow crystals grow from its chest area.

stills.title: Demonic Blacksmith Ritual
stills.description: A red demonic figure with a glowing blue face and green spiky hair stands at a stone anvil hammering a piece of metal that glows red hot. His hands grip a large hammer and the metal on the anvil while bright red and blue beams of light shine down from a swirling vortex above filled with green and blue marks and runes painted on the picture.

stills.title: Demon Blacksmith
stills.description: A muscular red and green demon with large blue wings kneels while holding a glowing green hammer in one hand and touching a red anvil with the other. The scene shows an open dark door with purple light behind it, scattered books and coins on the floor, and dramatic smoke filling the space.

stills.title: Spellforge
stills.description: A painting shows two figures from behind, one blue and one red-orange, standing back to back inside a metal cauldron with their arms raised and hands touching overhead to form an arch. The blue figure is surrounded by green energy and the red by fiery red energy, with swirling colorful patterns, handprints, and floating painted notes around them against a dark starry background.

stills.title: Three Figures with Book
stills.description: A man sits in the center holding an open book titled STASIS while yellow liquid pours from his head down his chest. Two yellow women with long hair touch him, one on each side, in a dark ruined room with papers and tools scattered on the floor.

stills.title: Golden Figure in Basin
stills.description: A golden three-headed figure sits in a large copper basin filled with yellow liquid. The figure has closed eyes, a wreath on its head, one hand on its chest and the other holding a quill that drips yellow, with light beams shining down from above.

stills.title: Man in Yellow Bath
stills.description: A muscular man sits in a large round copper tub filled with thick yellow liquid. His head is tilted up with eyes closed, yellow lines cover his body, and he holds a black book with both hands while yellow liquid drips from the stone walls and ceiling above.

stills.title: Anvil Dragon Painting
stills.description: A metal dragon with bat-like wings and a spiral eye sits on a copper anvil, vomiting yellow liquid covered in paint that pools on the cracked floor. Floating nearby are a hammer labeled Nurhan, a chisel, and pliers, all set against yellow cracked walls covered in paint marks and writing.

stills.title: Mysterious Library Chamber
stills.description: A person sees a large open book with spiral patterns resting on a gnarled tree root desk in an old stone room filled with tall bookshelves and lit candles. Two hooded figures sit at a broken window looking at each other with their hands touching an open book between them while a hanging lantern glows above and scattered papers lie on the floor.

stills.title: Wizard in Ancient Chamber
stills.description: A hooded figure in a brown robe kneels on a stone floor with both hands touching glowing orange marks and runes painted on the ground. The setting is a dark stone room with a large carved door leaking molten orange light, scattered scrolls, an overturned pot, and a night sky with a crescent moon visible through an opening.

stills.title: Wizard at Work
stills.description: A bald man in a blue robe covered with marks sits at a black desk and writes with a quill in his right hand while his left hand touches a glowing blue shape on the paper. The room has stone walls covered with papers that have marks and runes painted on them, a window showing green light in the sky, and tables filled with a compass, magnifying glass, jars, and plants.

stills.title: Mysterious Figure on Bridge
stills.description: A hooded figure in a long flowing cloak stands on an old stone bridge covered in moss and paint markings. The person's face is hidden by the hood and their hands are not visible as the cloak trails behind them with glowing tree patterns and swirling flowers and leaves over dark water that reflects the entire scene.

stills.title: Woman with Books by Water
stills.description: A woman in a blue and pink robe stands on a stone wall beside water. She holds an open book in one hand and reaches toward floating books with the other.

stills.title: Armored Figure on Anvil
stills.description: A figure in full metal armor sits on a large cracked anvil with glowing orange lines, arms crossed over its chest. The figure has a glowing purple crystal for a head emitting smoke and a white rose hovers above it inside a large circular metal ring covered in painted marks and runes, all set against a swirling dark purple background with floating objects and green aurora lights at the bottom.

stills.title: Mystic Weaving Loom
stills.description: A person's hand holds a shuttle and works on a wooden weaving loom that sits on an unrolled scroll. Golden liquid drips from the top scroll down into a pool of water below while glowing geometric shapes float in the dark background.

stills.title: Mysterious Cosmic Altar
stills.description: A person's hand with a ring rests on a dark floating table covered in circles and painted marks. Above the table a glowing heart shape made of lines floats in the air with light and smoke rising from the center while white moths fly nearby.

stills.title: Woman with Armillary Sphere
stills.description: A woman with her hair in a bun sits on a stool facing an armillary sphere and an open book. Her right hand touches the book which has a red wax seal and dripping red liquid while torn pages with marks lie on the floor; she holds a tool in her left hand. The setting is inside a room with a large circular stained glass window showing stars and patterns against a twilight sky, surrounded by swirling colorful clouds. The colors are deep blues, golds, reds, and purples.

stills.title: Mystic Crystal on Chalkboard
stills.description: A large glowing crystal ball rests on a black chalkboard covered in colorful paint marks and writing. A lit candle, brass compass, scattered papers, and lavender sprigs sit around the board against a dark blue textured wall.

stills.title: Spellforge Muse
stills.description: A painting shows a female figure with a mask-like face covered in symbols standing beside a large blackboard filled with painted marks and writing. Her hands touch a glowing quill that drips golden liquid while colorful threads flow from her head and body into the dark background filled with floating torn papers bearing painted marks.

stills.title: Girl with Scroll Machine
stills.description: A girl with a long braid stands with her back to the viewer in a room covered in paint marks and writing. Her left hand touches a large mechanical wheel device that holds a long curling scroll filled with writing while her right hand holds an abacus.

stills.title: Mysterious Hands at Table
stills.description: A person sees three colored hands reaching over a wooden table covered in papers with painted marks and runes. The blue hand from the top left holds a torn paper, the purple hand at bottom holds a drawing compass, and the golden hand on the right holds a coin over another paper, all around a glowing glass orb with a black rose inside.

stills.title: Colorful Paint Splatter
stills.description: The picture shows an abstract composition of vibrant paint splashes and drips on a white background. Bright bursts of yellow, green, orange, blue, and purple form flowing shapes with thick drips running downward across the surface.

stills.title: Abstract Paint Splatter
stills.description: The picture shows an abstract composition of colorful paint splatters, drips, and blended shapes on a white background. Bright yellow, green, orange, and blue paints form organic blobs, circular forms, and vertical drips that spread across the center and edges.

stills.title: Colorful Abstract Menu
stills.description: A person sees a bright abstract painting with a large white menu overlay that has three horizontal bars and three colored circles. The background shows rounded plant shapes, a yellow hat on the ground, and many colorful orbs in a vibrant setting.

stills.title: Abstract Bottle Painting
stills.description: A person sees an abstract painting of a pink bottle standing upright in the center with a white cork in its top. The bottle has various painted marks in blue white and black with a pink square near its base and is surrounded by large areas of pink orange and blue paint with visible brush strokes and drips.

stills.title: Wanderer in Pink Desert
stills.description: A person in dark clothes stands on a sand dune holding a long staff while looking into the distance. The hands hold the staff and the setting is a vast desert with a trail of rocks and footprints leading to the figure under a solid pink sky.

stills.title: Knight Facing Dragon
stills.description: A knight in full armor with a red cape stands on rocky ground holding a sword pointed forward. In the sky above looms a large brown dragon looking down at the knight.

stills.title: Woman with Red Hair
stills.description: A woman with fair skin and bright wavy red hair looks directly at the viewer. She wears a low-cut light blue dress with gold patterns and lace trim, long dangling earrings, and has faint gold star marks painted on her chest and neck.

stills.title: Woman with Orange Hair
stills.description: A woman with long flowing orange hair looks down and to the side with a neutral expression. Her right hand rests on her upper chest near her shoulder while a small dark silhouette of a figure stands on a wooden boat-like shape across her chest and shoulder area against a light background with orange paint marks.

stills.title: Figure in Red Robe on Rocks
stills.description: A person wearing a long red robe sits on dark jagged rocks looking toward a dramatic sky. The person's face is in profile, their hands rest on the rocks, and the setting is a rocky outcrop under a sky filled with swirling orange, yellow, and dark clouds.

stills.title: Surreal Gathering Scene
stills.description: A group of people in a dimly lit room with a large bed, small tables, food, and objects including a gun and a clock. Above them swirls a giant orange moon with orbiting spheres, a floating figure in red cloth, and a large black bird flying through white clouds against a fiery sky.

stills.title: Pink Alien on Rock
stills.description: A pink alien creature with large black eyes and two antennae sits on a gray rock covered in green moss. Its hands touch the top of the rock while orange rectangles float all around against a solid green background.

stills.title: Pink Octopus at Sunset
stills.description: A large pink octopus with big black eyes sits on a rocky outcrop covered in green moss. Its tentacles touch the rock as it looks out over a calm body of water toward a city skyline with a bridge and construction cranes under a huge yellow sun in an orange sky.

stills.title: Alien on Rocky Peak
stills.description: A large white spherical alien creature with red spots, a single huge black eye, and multiple pink tentacles stands on an orange and green rocky peak. Several small white eyeballs on thin stalks extend from its head while other detached eyeballs float nearby against a swirling red background.

stills.title: Pink Alien on Lava Rock
stills.description: A pink alien creature with large black eyes and a white egg-shaped body covered in red spots stands on a mossy rock. Its pink hands touch the rock while orange lava flows down from the rock into a swirling red and black background with three white spheres floating nearby.

stills.title: Green Alien Emerging
stills.description: A green alien with a large head, big black eyes with red slits, and blue lips has red liquid dripping from its mouth. Its pink tentacle-like arms with claws are touching a broken rocky ledge, set against a cracked white background with dark smoke and a black void behind it.

stills.title: Skeleton and Octopus on Cliff
stills.description: A hooded skeleton in a dark blue robe stands in a wooden boat with one hand extended, next to a large pink octopus creature with big eyes and a toothy grin that has several tentacles wrapped around the boat. The boat rests on a rocky cliff covered in yellow grass that floats in a cosmic sky filled with green and purple swirling nebulae, stars, and clouds.

stills.title: Cosmic Reaper on Cliff
stills.description: A skeletal figure in a dark hooded robe stands in an old wooden boat perched on a mossy rock cliff. The skeleton has long purple tentacles instead of a body and is reaching out with golden skeletal hands while a pink octopus like creature with big green eyes and many tentacles floats beside it under a starry sky with swirling green and blue galaxies.

stills.title: Skeleton Wizard and Pink Creature
stills.description: A skeleton wizard in a blue robe and tall hat stands on an old wooden boat with arms raised and hands open. A pink creature with big eyes and sharp teeth clings to the side of the boat while the vessel rests on a rocky outcrop in crashing waves under a swirling green and purple cosmic sky.

stills.title: Floating Boat in Cosmic Sky
stills.description: A hooded figure stands in a wooden Viking-style boat that floats above golden rolling hills, with one hand extended toward a glowing yellow sun on the horizon. The sky blends from orange sunset to deep blue night filled with stars, while a large swirling green and purple cosmic cloud with glowing eyes dominates the left side.

stills.title: Blue Circles Over Hills
stills.description: A person sees many blue circles of different sizes floating across the upper part of the picture. Below them are rolling hills covered in green and yellow fields with dark trees under a swirling red orange and yellow sky with a small yellow sun near the middle.

stills.title: Vibrant Swirling Sky Over Fields
stills.description: A person sees a bright yellow sun setting on the horizon with swirling orange and red patterns filling the sky above rolling hills and green fields. Many large blue circles of different sizes float across the upper part of the scene with smaller blue dots scattered around them.

stills.title: Blue Flowers
stills.description: The picture shows large round blue flowers with thick painted petals on green stems. The background is filled with bright swirling circles and dots in yellow orange red and pink.

stills.title: Lighthouse on Cliff
stills.description: A tall lighthouse with a red band stands on a green cliff above the sea. Its bright beam shines out into the purple foggy sky while small buildings sit on the grassy slope below.

stills.title: Hot Air Balloons in Sky
stills.description: A person sees many colorful hot air balloons floating in a blue sky with white clouds. The largest yellow balloon is in the center with people visible in its basket, while smaller balloons in red, purple, orange, and striped patterns fill the scene around it.

stills.title: Rolling Hills and Fields
stills.description: A person sees a wide view of green fields in the foreground with patches of grass and small bushes. Beyond them are large bright yellow fields, a blue body of water, and distant blue and green mountains under a white sky.

stills.title: Desert Valley View
stills.description: A person sees a wide open desert in the foreground with orange sand, dry bushes, and grasses. In the distance are large rocky mountains, green and yellow fields in a valley, and scattered trees under a bright white sky.

stills.title: Abstract Blue Circles Painting
stills.description: The picture shows many blue circles and dots of different sizes floating over swirling colorful brushstrokes. The background has energetic swirls of bright orange, yellow, pink and red paint with visible brush marks and splatters.

stills.title: Surreal Tower with Planets
stills.description: A tall clock tower stands in the center of a green hilly setting with small buildings around its base. Many colorful planets and orbs float in a circular teal space around the tower along with several butterflies and a bat while a large green planet appears behind the tower.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower Sphere
stills.description: A tall ornate clock tower stands inside a large transparent sphere that rests on green rolling hills. The tower has multiple clock faces and is surrounded by colorful spheres, butterflies, and birds while the base shows a large circular design with painted marks.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower Scene
stills.description: A large green clock tower shaped like a sphere with a white clock face stands in the center of rolling green hills under a big teal circular sky. Butterflies, birds, colorful spheres, and a small house appear on the path and in the air around tall rocks and distant mountains.

stills.title: Silhouette Woman Over City
stills.description: A large black silhouette of a woman's face and shoulders dominates the upper part of the scene with a bright yellow full moon where her mouth would be. In the foreground many smaller black silhouettes of people stand near a body of reflective water with one central woman in a long dress reaching toward the water while the background shows a city skyline under a colorful sky.

stills.title: Desert Hills with Mountains
stills.description: A person sees a wide desert plain covered in bright orange sand with clumps of dark spiky grass and bushes in the foreground. In the distance are rolling tan and brown hills that lead to a range of blue mountains with white peaks under a large empty white sky.

stills.title: Desert Mountains
stills.description: A person sees black mountains stretching across the middle of the picture with bushes and plants in the foreground on white ground. The upper part shows a bright white sky with thick white paint strokes.

stills.title: Knight Facing Dragon
stills.description: A knight in full silver armor and a flowing red cape stands on the left holding a long sword with both hands pointed at a large purple dragon on the right. The dragon has an open mouth with the sword blade inside it while the knight looks up at the beast against a colorful painted background.

stills.title: Rolling Hills
stills.description: A person sees a wide view of rolling hills and farmland with scattered trees and winding paths. The setting has distant mountains under a bright sky and uses shades of black white and gray.

stills.title: Dog on Bicycle
stills.description: A tan dog with white markings sits upright on a bicycle, its front paws resting on the handlebars as it looks to the left. The setting is a plain wall with soft light and some orange paint marks, and the colors are warm browns, white, silver, and red.

stills.title: Green Faced Figure Over Theater
stills.description: A large green faced person with black hair and a black cloak stands in the foreground looking forward with a serious expression. In the background through an archway is an outdoor theater stage with red curtains and a crowd of people watching at sunset.

stills.title: Dog at Outdoor Concert
stills.description: A black and brown dog with a tag collar sits in the foreground looking at the viewer surrounded by pink flowers and a large crowd of people. Behind them is a stone archway framing a stage with a city skyline and a large yellow sun setting in an orange sky.

stills.title: Yellow Dog with Purple Flowers
stills.description: A close up view of a yellow Labrador retriever's face and shoulders. The dog looks directly forward with brown eyes and a black nose while surrounded by a dense background of purple flowers.

stills.title: Yellow Dog with Flowers
stills.description: A yellow Labrador retriever with a black nose looks directly at the viewer. The dog is surrounded by a background of colorful hibiscus flowers in shades of purple, orange, pink, and yellow.

stills.title: Three Birds in Desert
stills.description: Three large birds stand in a row on yellow sand. A black bird covered in white marks is on the left, a brown bird is in the middle, and a white bird is on the right, with a pale sun in the sky above.

stills.title: Three Black Birds Painting
stills.description: A painting shows three large black birds standing on brown ground with scattered white and orange flowers. Two birds stand side by side on the left while the third bird stands inside an orange rectangular frame on the right.

stills.title: Three Black Crows on Branch
stills.description: Three black crows perch on a thick wooden branch. The left crow faces right with its beak near the middle crow's beak while the right crow looks left toward the others.

stills.title: Dog at Computer
stills.description: A brown dog sits at a wooden desk and uses a keyboard with its front paws. The dog looks at a large computer monitor that shows one short word painted in orange.

stills.title: Desert Hills
stills.description: A person sees rolling hills and distant mountains under a pale sky with light blue streaks. The setting has orange and yellow ground with dark bushes and grass in the foreground.

stills.title: Dog on Bicycle
stills.description: A small orange and white dog with big upright ears and a blue collar looks directly at the viewer while sitting on a bicycle. Its front paws rest on the handlebars against a simple painted background of beige, gray, and orange tones.

stills.title: Mountain Valley Drawing
stills.description: The picture shows a wide valley with a winding path leading through hills covered in dark bushes and trees. In the background are large mountains with shaded slopes under a bright white sky.

stills.title: Dog on Bicycle
stills.description: A brown dog with floppy ears and a black collar is sitting on a bicycle and looking straight at the viewer with its front paws resting on the handlebars. The background is an abstract painted wall with orange, green, and purple colors.

stills.title: Three Travelers at Sunrise
stills.description: Three people in robes walk away from the viewer across a hilly plain covered in dry grass and white flowers. The center figure holds a tall spear in his right hand while the left and right figures each carry a smaller spear.

stills.title: Woman Portrait
stills.description: The picture shows a close-up of a woman's face turned slightly to the right. Her skin has orange tones, she has bright green eyes with dark lashes, dark eyebrows, and glossy red lips, set against an abstract background of green, orange, and purple brush strokes.

stills.title: Desert Canyon Drawing
stills.description: A person sees a black and white ink drawing of rocky mesas and buttes rising above rolling desert hills. In the foreground are clumps of desert grasses and shrubs, with the ground showing faint paths winding between the formations under a large empty white sky.

stills.title: Dog at Retro Computer
stills.description: A brown and white dog with large pointed ears sits at a white desk between two old computers. Its front paws rest on a keyboard while a brown and red object lies on the desk in front of it; the left monitor shows text and the right computer has a damaged case.

stills.title: Surreal Clock
stills.description: A large round clock face hangs on a plain wall. The clock shows a green hill scene in the center with a path and tower, and its face holds many small objects like butterflies, a bat, balls, tools, and a small watch.

stills.title: Surreal clock scene
stills.description: A large round clock with Roman numerals has its face replaced by a green hilly scene with a path, trees, a frog, and many butterflies and birds flying around it. In the center is a tall tower structure on a sphere with a smaller clock face whose hands point to ten minutes past ten.

stills.title: Surreal Clock
stills.description: A large round clock shows a tower on a big sphere at its center with hands pointing to ten past six. The top half has a blue sky with butterflies bats a globe a skull and other objects while the bottom has yellow sand with more bats a bottle and small spheres.

stills.title: Abstract Geometric Painting
stills.description: A person sees overlapping translucent geometric shapes like diamonds and triangles arranged in layers. The shapes in pink, yellow, orange, and green sit above and below a dark horizontal band against a light gray background.

stills.title: Abstract Color Blocks
stills.description: The picture shows an abstract painting with large blocks of overlapping color. A person's eye sees vertical and horizontal brushstrokes of teal, orange, purple, and green against a soft lavender background.

stills.title: Abstract Lake Scene
stills.description: The picture shows a body of water in the foreground with yellow grass on its banks and orange hills behind it under a sky filled with white and blue clouds. The water reflects the bright orange and blue colors from the land and sky above.

stills.title: Rural Sunset Painting
stills.description: A person sees a colorful painted scene of fields with small houses and dark hills under a bright sky filled with orange, red, and yellow clouds. The foreground has dark brushstrokes and a bush while the middle ground shows yellow and green fields with scattered trees.

stills.title: Abstract Orange Painting
stills.description: A person sees an abstract painting with thick layers of orange and yellow paint applied in broad strokes and drips. The surface shows many marks of paint, some white brush strokes, and several small red dots placed across the composition.

stills.title: Colorful Field at Sunset
stills.description: A person sees an open field with rolling hills under a big sky filled with white and blue clouds. The ground has patches of bright orange, yellow, red, and green with some dark trees and a small orange sun low on the horizon.

stills.title: Spiraling Color Swirls
stills.description: The picture shows many overlapping circular brushstroke swirls in different sizes that create a flowing abstract pattern. The setting is a white canvas with visible paint splatters and marks throughout, using colors of pink, purple, blue, and yellow.

stills.title: Colorful Alley with Stairs
stills.description: A person sees a narrow alley between bright yellow and orange buildings with a stone staircase leading up the middle. Many potted plants and flowers in pink yellow and green sit on the colorful cobblestone path and steps under a clear blue sky.

stills.title: Colorful Mediterranean Alley
stills.description: A person sees a narrow alleyway between bright yellow and orange buildings with blue shutters and arched doorways. The cobblestone path is lined with many potted flowers in pink, yellow, and green, with hanging flower baskets on the walls under a clear blue sky.

stills.title: Abstract Geometric Painting
stills.description: The picture shows an abstract composition of bold geometric shapes including triangles, rectangles, and circles arranged in a vertical format. A large black angular shape cuts through orange, pink, gray, and green sections with scattered yellow dots, paint drips, and brush marks against a white background.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny Portrait
stills.description: A person sees Bugs Bunny from Looney Tunes as the main subject, shown from the chest up with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a wide grin showing teeth, large white eyes, long upright ears with pink insides, and his hands are not visible; the setting is an abstract painted background with bold brush strokes.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny and friends
stills.description: A painting shows three cartoon rabbits standing in a row. On the left is a brown rabbit with a long snout and big smile, in the middle is a gray rabbit with hands on hips, and on the right is a gray rabbit wearing a red bow tie with one hand on his chin.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with Carrot and Fruit
stills.description: A large central Bugs Bunny smiles widely at the viewer while giving a thumbs up with one hand and holding a large carrot with the other, his big foot raised toward the camera. Many smaller Bugs Bunny characters in different costumes and poses surround him against a colorful striped background filled with oranges, tomatoes, and other round fruits and balls.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with Looney Tunes friends
stills.description: A large central Bugs Bunny stands smiling with his hands clasped in front of his chest and one foot raised, wearing white gloves and showing his big white feet. To his left is a smaller Bugs Bunny with arms crossed, to his right is the Tasmanian Devil wearing a straw hat and standing on a bush, with several smaller cartoon characters, hearts, and butterflies around them on a painted background with colorful drips at the bottom.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with Looney Tunes
stills.description: A giant Bugs Bunny stands in the center smiling with his hands forward. Many other Looney Tunes characters and people surround him including Daffy Duck, the Tasmanian Devil, Lola Bunny, and several human figures against a colorful painted background.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with friends
stills.description: A large Bugs Bunny stands in the center with his hands on his hips and one foot resting on a big round object that has a red lens. His face shows a wide smile with teeth and he is surrounded by many smaller versions of himself and one other rabbit character all in different poses with hearts floating around.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny Magic Show
stills.description: A gray rabbit with a big smile stands behind a red round table and touches a small red bottle with both hands. In a crowded city street at night many people and cartoon characters watch from all sides under bright lights and a glowing yellow orb in the sky.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with Looney Tunes characters
stills.description: A large Bugs Bunny stands in the center with his hands on his hips smiling at the viewer. Several smaller Looney Tunes characters surround him including a small bear on a striped ball to the left a duck and devil character on a striped ball to the right and two tiny characters on the ground near a small wooden box.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Landscape
stills.description: A person sees a large circular painting of a clock tower built on a green hill with a winding path, set inside a bigger round scene. The clock face shows Roman numerals and its hands point near ten to two, while butterflies, bats, colored spheres, and stars float in the sky above the hills and mountains.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower
stills.description: A large round clock with hands and numbers sits on a tall tower atop a green hill with a path inside a big green circle. The setting shows floating colorful spheres, butterflies, bats, a sun, and rocky formations against a pale background.

stills.title: Butterflies over Eyeball Field
stills.description: A person sees many butterflies flying in the sky above a green grassy hill. The ground is covered with large white eyeballs that have orange and blue irises scattered in the grass under a cloudy sky.

stills.title: Bald Man with Oranges
stills.description: A bald man with a large dark mustache is shown in profile looking up, his head and neck emerging from a dark blue background. He is surrounded by many bright orange fruits with leaves scattered all around him.

stills.title: Bald Man with Mustache
stills.description: A bald man with a prominent yellowish mustache is shown from the shoulders up in profile, looking upward and to the left with his head tilted back. He wears a dark shirt against a solid dark brown and black background.

stills.title: Skeleton in Blue Suit
stills.description: A skeleton wearing a blue suit, vest, and fedora stands on a pile of broken bricks holding two briefcases. The skeleton's skull rests on the bricks in the foreground while a wooden barrel and crate sit nearby under a large dead tree against a big orange sun.

stills.title: Man with Briefcase on Skulls
stills.description: A man in a dark suit and hat walks forward while holding a black briefcase in his right hand. He stands on a pile of large blue blocks and golden skulls with his face showing deep lines and a grim expression.

stills.title: Cosmic Portal over Meadow
stills.description: A person sees a swirling black hole in space with rings of green blue and brown surrounded by thick white clouds that form a circular tunnel against a starry dark sky. Below it are rolling green hills covered in red flowers.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower Scene
stills.description: A person sees a tall brown clock tower standing on a hill in the center of a giant circular clock face that forms a tunnel through green hills. The tower has two visible clock faces with hands, and a winding path marked with painted numbers leads from the bottom of the image up to the tower while a starry sphere hangs in the sky above it.

stills.title: Orange Pattern with Spiral
stills.description: A person sees a repeating pattern of whole oranges, orange slices, and green leaves scattered across a dark background. In the center is a large black spiral that looks like it is swirling inward.

stills.title: Black Hole Painting
stills.description: The picture shows a large circular form with glowing white rings at its center surrounded by dark swirling bands. The setting is a deep black space dotted with small white specks and some orange marks on the outer rings.

stills.title: Black Hole Painting
stills.description: A painting shows a large black hole with a jagged torn edge in the center of swirling dark space. Many metallic spheres of different sizes float around the hole and in the surrounding dark void with small white dots.

stills.title: Man Taking Selfie in Mirror
stills.description: A man with dark hair and a beard holds a black smartphone in his right hand while taking a selfie in a mirror. He stares directly at the viewer with a neutral expression from a dark setting with a small patch of light around his face and upper body.

stills.title: Man in Dark Frame
stills.description: A man with short dark hair and a beard stares directly forward with a serious expression. He stands inside a tall thin rectangular frame against a solid black background holding a small dark rectangular object in his raised right hand.

stills.title: Man in Mirror
stills.description: A man with short dark hair and a beard stands in a dark room and looks straight ahead while holding a smartphone in his right hand to take a picture of his reflection. The setting is dimly lit with deep shadows, a wooden floor, and a tall rectangular mirror or doorway with a faint glowing frame.

stills.title: Person Holding Phone
stills.description: A person holds a black smartphone with both hands directly in front of their face hiding it from view. The hands are touching the sides of the phone while the subject stands inside a glowing red rectangular frame against a dark background.

stills.title: Man in Phone Frame
stills.description: A man with a beard and dark hoodie stands centered looking forward with a serious expression. His hands are in the pockets of his hoodie. The setting is inside a large painted smartphone frame with a colorful border against a dark background.

stills.title: Mirror Self Portrait
stills.description: A person sees a framed mirror hanging on a dark wall inside a narrow painted doorway. The man's face looks directly forward while his hands hold a black phone he is touching, in a room with a red curved seat visible to the side.

stills.title: Surreal Forest Path
stills.description: A person sees a dark path with black and white checkered floor leading into a misty forest of bare trees. The scene has large dripping red and dark shapes hanging from the top and sides like torn curtains or paint.

stills.title: Deer in Forest Painting
stills.description: A brown deer with large antlers stands facing forward in the center of the picture. The deer is in a forest with tall dark green trees behind it and red and yellow flowers at its feet.

stills.title: Man at Anvil with Runes
stills.description: A person with short gray hair and a halo sits centered facing forward with a serious face and both hands resting on a dark anvil. The setting is inside a brick structure with arched openings showing a starry night sky while glowing ghostly shirts float around the figure with marks and paint on them and ropes hang from the anvil.

stills.title: Horned Figure with Scroll
stills.description: A black horned figure with pink drips on its face sits on swirling green cloth against a black background. The figure holds an open green scroll with paint writing while three glowing orbs float nearby showing silhouettes of people and night scenes with a moon.

stills.title: Horned Figure by the Lake
stills.description: A black horned silhouette with pink tears sits on a rock in dark water, one hand touching a flowering tree branch with yellow blossoms. The scene shows a pink swirling sky with blue eyes, broken black shapes above, glowing blue orbs containing couples, golden fish, green plants, and tall dark stones with painted marks, all reflected in the calm water.

stills.title: Mystic Loom Workshop
stills.description: A person sees a hooded figure standing at a wooden table inside a stone room with arched windows. The figure's hands touch a white t-shirt and glowing threads on a large loom that holds a long fabric covered in painted marks and runes while an open book, tools, and a lit candle sit on the table in front.

stills.title: Horned Figure by Ruins
stills.description: A black silhouette of a horned female figure sits on a stone altar draped in green cloth. Her face shows glowing pink eyes and long flowing pink tears while one hand touches a flowering branch and the other rests on the stone.

stills.title: Demon Reading
stills.description: A black demon with horns and a long tail sits on a green table covered by a cloth. The demon looks up at three floating picture frames that show silhouettes of people under flowering branches while its hand rests on an open book with paint marks on the cover.

stills.title: Horned Figure with Cherry Tree
stills.description: A horned female figure with a starry dark blue body sits on a large green tree stump. Her right hand holds a bubble showing two silhouetted people under a moon while pink liquid drips from her fingers onto the stump and into a dark pool below.

stills.title: Horned Figure by Mystic Tree
stills.description: A person sees a horned black silhouette figure standing in water with glowing blue patterns on its body and long flowing hair. The figure's hands reach toward a large twisted green tree covered in yellow flowers while holding a sheet of music that drips black paint into the reflective water below.

stills.title: Surreal Skull Music Scene
stills.description: A large cracked green skull wearing red glasses sits in a broken purple room with rain falling from a stormy sky visible through the ceiling. A hairless cat with glasses writes on sheet music in the skull's mouth, while a blue-haired armored woman with a glowing staff floats nearby, two skeleton figures in black robes play saxophone and hold papers on a red spiral rug, and small skeletons emerge from potion bottles as musical notes float through the air.

stills.title: Skull Band with Wizard Cat
stills.description: A large green skull wearing sunglasses sits in the center on a wooden floor with its mouth open. A wizard cat with glasses stands on the skull holding a glowing staff while two skeleton musicians play a saxophone and drum beside it.

stills.title: Skeleton Ballet
stills.description: A green skull with red sunglasses sits on a stage and watches a hairless cat in a pink tutu dance on a stool while holding up a book titled DESPAIR and a red feather. Skeletons in ballet skirts play music and dance around a snowy floor covered in papers and feathers as purple smoke and musical notes float through the air.

stills.title: Enchanted Ballet Stage
stills.description: A ballerina in a pink tutu dances on one leg while a man in armor holds her waist and a ghostly blue figure projects light from a large movie camera. In the foreground an open book labeled DESPAIR lies on the floor with a sword through it next to a second fallen ballerina and scattered film reels. The scene is a dark theatrical stage with heavy curtains icicles and colored stage lights.

stills.title: Psychedelic Forest Ritual
stills.description: A blue-skinned woman in a pink tutu floats upside down in the air with one leg extended high while another identical woman lies on the snowy ground below. A knight in green armor kneels in the snow holding open a large glowing book that emits purple smoke and colorful drips as two bandaged mummies stand among the trees watching.

stills.title: Cosmic Ballet Dancers
stills.description: Three blue-skinned ballerinas perform a dramatic lift and pose in a swirling cosmic setting. Their colorful tutus and bodies drip with bright paint as glowing stars and leaves float around them against a dark starry sky with lightning.

stills.title: Dancing Ballerinas in Space
stills.description: A person sees two ballerinas dancing together in the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. One ballerina in a green dress stands on one leg holding a broom that shoots sparks while the other in a pink dress does a split on a colorful tiled floor with a small green dragon beside her holding a glowing orb.

stills.title: Fantasy Clockwork Vortex
stills.description: A large skeletal dragon wearing a purple hooded cloak flies through a swirling vortex of time and magic with its mouth open and orange tongue out. Below it a green and blue flying elephant with wings holds a purple orb while a witch on a broomstick flies nearby and a green beetle carries a large clock as multiple hot air balloons shaped like clocks float in the background.

stills.title: Skeleton on Pier
stills.description: A skeleton in a purple hooded robe stands on a wooden pier over water. The skeleton holds a red dripping gun in one hand and an alarm clock in the other while red paint runs down the pier.

stills.title: Surreal Desert Eye Scene
stills.description: A woman in a red robe and headscarf walks barefoot across sand dunes with small cacti around her. Above her floats a giant eye with a red mouse inside its pupil, a green vine, and another red mouse standing on a red and yellow sphere, all surrounded by transparent bubbles containing small desert scenes.

stills.title: Desert Bubble Dream
stills.description: A large red mouse in a purple robe stands on a sand dune and blows bubbles from a small wand held in its hand. Above float many iridescent bubbles containing tiny desert scenes with cacti, smaller mice, and robed figures while a glowing red eye watches from the sky over a colorful geometric dome that leaks liquid onto the sand.

stills.title: Mosaic Woman Portrait
stills.description: A woman with a green and blue mosaic face has her mouth open as if shouting. Her hair flows out in colorful swirls filled with white horses, flowers, and vines while a dog in a ruff collar stands on a ledge to the right and looks at floating orbs that contain faces.

stills.title: ethereal woman with dog
stills.description: A woman with pale skin, blue eyes, and mosaic patterns on her face looks upward from the center of the image. Her hands are not visible touching anything while a grey dog in a ruffled collar and armor stands beside her on a cracked reflective surface that shows their reflections below.

stills.title: Hooded Figure with Candles
stills.description: A hooded figure in a long black robe stands barefoot on a dark platform covered in glowing marks and water. The figure has no visible face and holds hands out toward three lit candles floating in the air while three dark birds fly around with glowing ribbons and three pale hands rise from below holding small houses and figures.

stills.title: Mystic Sorceress with Birds and Flowers
stills.description: A woman in a dark hooded robe stands with arms outstretched, her face pale with a neutral expression. Her hands are open with one releasing glowing particles and the other near floating marks and runes, while birds fly around her, flowers grow from the cracked dark ground, and two glowing orbs with small scenes sit on either side. The setting shows ruined stone towers under a dramatic sky filled with colorful swirling clouds, a large eye symbol, and a cracked full moon.

stills.title: Fat Armored Warrior
stills.description: A very large and obese man with a bare tattooed torso sits on a stone throne wearing black metal armor and a book on his head. His gloved hands rest on an open book on one side and an anvil on the other while papers and candles surround him in a fiery purple setting.

stills.title: Armored Figure with Scales
stills.description: A heavy person in black metal armor sits on a dark stone platform with eyes closed. The right hand holds a white feather pen and writes in an open book resting on the lap while the left hand rests on a large decorated shield and the feet stand on another burning book.

stills.title: Mystical Tree of Life
stills.description: A person sees a huge gnarled tree with a round bulbous trunk covered in golden paint marks and branches holding colorful stained glass leaves. The tree grows from a starry reflective pool at the bottom where a white robed figure with flowing cloth touches a circular pattern on the water surface, two hands reach from the sides toward the tree, waterfalls flow from the branches, and a glowing castle sits at the very top under a starry sky with aurora lights.

stills.title: Mysterious Cloaked Figure
stills.description: A cloaked figure with a pale face floats above a circular pool of water with glowing patterns on its surface. The figure's hands reach down toward the pool while a giant gnarled tree with paint on its bark stretches across the starry sky with waterfalls flowing from its branches.

stills.title: 1000-Pound Stasis Diver
stills.description: A large heavyset woman with gray hair floats in the air above a round celestial pool. Her face looks focused, her hands reach down toward the glowing water where her own reflection lies at the bottom, and water falls from a giant tree above her.

stills.title: Floating Figure in Cosmic Scene
stills.description: A woman with closed eyes floats upside down in the center of the image, wearing a shiny green and gold patterned bodysuit and a black head covering with a white flower design. Her arms are outstretched with hands open, not touching anything, above a glowing circular pool on broken rocky ground that has waterfalls flowing down into darkness, with twisted bare trees on both sides and colorful aurora lights filling the space.

stills.title: Diving Figure
stills.description: A heavy woman with light skin and purple patterned clothes stands barefoot on the edge of a diving board above dark water. Her hands reach forward and her face looks down toward her large black shadow that spreads across the glowing pond below.

stills.title: Woman on Diving Board
stills.description: A heavy woman in a purple swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a high diving board with one hand on the board and the other on the railing. Below her is an indoor pool with glowing blue, green, and purple swirling patterns and a dark silhouette at the center, set in a tiled room with a purple skylight above.

stills.title: Man Jumping into Pool
stills.description: A large heavy man with a black swim cap is captured mid-air as he jumps into a swimming pool with arms outstretched and a smile on his face. His hands are not touching anything, the setting is an outdoor pool area at dusk with a diving board above, colorful pool noodles floating in the glowing turquoise water, and a single purple swim fin visible underwater near his reflection.

stills.title: Woman Jumping into Pool
stills.description: A heavy woman with wet curly dark hair is captured mid-air as she jumps feet-first into a swimming pool, creating a big splash and colorful ripples. Her eyes are closed and mouth smiling, she wears a purple one-piece swimsuit with gold patterns, one hand touches the diving board while the other is outstretched, in an old indoor pool with painted walls.

stills.title: Couple Jumping in Pool
stills.description: A large man and a large woman are jumping into a swimming pool at night holding hands. Their reflections are visible in the glowing turquoise water below along with floating pool toys while steam rises around them.

stills.title: Two Women at Pool
stills.description: A light-skinned heavy woman wearing a crown and black swim bottoms is jumping into a pool with her mouth open and one hand raised while a dark-skinned heavy woman in a purple swimsuit stands on the edge pointing at her. The setting is a pool area at dusk with a diving board, pink flamingo float, unicorn pool toy, and palm trees in the background.

stills.title: Chained Figure with Shield
stills.description: A dark-skinned man with golden eyes and a spiked crown kneels on the floor of a stone chamber. His hands touch the ground and a large shield that rests against his body while chains bind his arms and neck.

stills.title: Weaver in the Chapel
stills.description: A hooded figure sits at a large wooden loom inside a gothic stone room. The person's hands touch a paper with a flower design while a glowing fiery object flies toward the loom and an hourglass, broken crown, and spilled bucket sit on a table in front.

stills.title: Blacksmith Forging Blue Crystal
stills.description: A hooded blacksmith stands at an anvil holding a hammer in one hand while the other touches a paper with marks and drawings. With tongs in a large gloved hand a glowing blue crystal is held above the anvil as blue liquid drips from it and from a large circular device hanging above covered in painted marks and runes. The stone walls are covered in painted marks and runes with blue birds and feathers scattered around. The scene uses dark blues, glowing cyan, brown, and gray stone colors.

stills.title: Cosmic Melting Clock Cauldron
stills.description: A large cracked white and gold cauldron with gears and dripping substance floats in the center of a swirling cosmic scene. Below it three blue hooded figures with clock faces for heads reach upward with their hands while floating books, hourglasses, gears and vines drift around them against a dark starry background with beams of light and three colored moons above.

stills.title: Cosmic Forge Figure
stills.description: A cracked female figure with a white face and blue energy stands behind an anvil with blue light and sparks coming from it. Her right hand holds a key while her left hand touches blue energy and paint marks cover the stone walls around her.

stills.title: Demonic Organ
stills.description: A person sees a large pipe organ built into a broken arched stone window with a blue demon having horns and one eye appearing inside the glass. The demon's hands reach out from the glass as blue liquid drips down over the keyboard and onto an open book on the floor that shows the word STASIS.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Eye
stills.description: A large wooden cuckoo clock with a giant blue eye for a face sits at the top of the picture dripping blue liquid. Below it a blue scaled mouth pours more blue liquid into swirling water where two hands reach up one with a scaled sleeve and the other with dragon wings on the fingers both wearing rings and touching a large ornate key.

stills.title: Kneeling Demon Knight
stills.description: A demon knight in red armor with horns and glowing eyes kneels inside a ruined cathedral. His hands hold a hammer and touch an anvil with a glowing red sword blade, while large blue and red fiery wings spread behind him and an open book rests nearby.

stills.title: Ruined Goddess with Black Hole
stills.description: A stone statue of a bare-chested woman with glowing blue flames for eyes and hair sits inside a broken circular stone structure covered in green vines. Two large black birds fly near a massive black hole with a red fiery ring in a dark red sky while a third bird flies lower; broken stone pillars, scattered carved stones with paint marks, and glowing blue liquid appear in the foreground.

stills.title: Fallen Statue and Ravens
stills.description: A cracked stone statue of a person lies on the ground with glowing blue eyes and green vines wrapped around its body. Two large black ravens fly above it with blue symbols painted on their wings while a stone figure stands nearby with one hand raised near a glowing golden crystal on a pedestal.

stills.title: Blue and Red Demons
stills.description: A blue demon with horns kneels on the left and reaches with both hands to touch a glowing yellow crystal formation. A large red demon with a curved horn on its head kneels on the right and also touches the same crystals with its hands while more yellow crystals grow from its chest area.

stills.title: Demonic Blacksmith Ritual
stills.description: A red demonic figure with a glowing blue face and green spiky hair stands at a stone anvil hammering a piece of metal that glows red hot. His hands grip a large hammer and the metal on the anvil while bright red and blue beams of light shine down from a swirling vortex above filled with green and blue marks and runes painted on the picture.

stills.title: Demon Blacksmith
stills.description: A muscular red and green demon with large blue wings kneels while holding a glowing green hammer in one hand and touching a red anvil with the other. The scene shows an open dark door with purple light behind it, scattered books and coins on the floor, and dramatic smoke filling the space.

stills.title: Spellforge
stills.description: A painting shows two figures from behind, one blue and one red-orange, standing back to back inside a metal cauldron with their arms raised and hands touching overhead to form an arch. The blue figure is surrounded by green energy and the red by fiery red energy, with swirling colorful patterns, handprints, and floating painted notes around them against a dark starry background.

stills.title: Three Figures with Book
stills.description: A man sits in the center holding an open book titled STASIS while yellow liquid pours from his head down his chest. Two yellow women with long hair touch him, one on each side, in a dark ruined room with papers and tools scattered on the floor.

stills.title: Golden Figure in Basin
stills.description: A golden three-headed figure sits in a large copper basin filled with yellow liquid. The figure has closed eyes, a wreath on its head, one hand on its chest and the other holding a quill that drips yellow, with light beams shining down from above.

stills.title: Man in Yellow Bath
stills.description: A muscular man sits in a large round copper tub filled with thick yellow liquid. His head is tilted up with eyes closed, yellow lines cover his body, and he holds a black book with both hands while yellow liquid drips from the stone walls and ceiling above.

stills.title: Anvil Dragon Painting
stills.description: A metal dragon with bat-like wings and a spiral eye sits on a copper anvil, vomiting yellow liquid covered in paint that pools on the cracked floor. Floating nearby are a hammer labeled Nurhan, a chisel, and pliers, all set against yellow cracked walls covered in paint marks and writing.

stills.title: Mysterious Library Chamber
stills.description: A person sees a large open book with spiral patterns resting on a gnarled tree root desk in an old stone room filled with tall bookshelves and lit candles. Two hooded figures sit at a broken window looking at each other with their hands touching an open book between them while a hanging lantern glows above and scattered papers lie on the floor.

stills.title: Wizard in Ancient Chamber
stills.description: A hooded figure in a brown robe kneels on a stone floor with both hands touching glowing orange marks and runes painted on the ground. The setting is a dark stone room with a large carved door leaking molten orange light, scattered scrolls, an overturned pot, and a night sky with a crescent moon visible through an opening.

stills.title: Wizard at Work
stills.description: A bald man in a blue robe covered with marks sits at a black desk and writes with a quill in his right hand while his left hand touches a glowing blue shape on the paper. The room has stone walls covered with papers that have marks and runes painted on them, a window showing green light in the sky, and tables filled with a compass, magnifying glass, jars, and plants.

stills.title: Mysterious Figure on Bridge
stills.description: A hooded figure in a long flowing cloak stands on an old stone bridge covered in moss and paint markings. The person's face is hidden by the hood and their hands are not visible as the cloak trails behind them with glowing tree patterns and swirling flowers and leaves over dark water that reflects the entire scene.

stills.title: Woman with Books by Water
stills.description: A woman in a blue and pink robe stands on a stone wall beside water. She holds an open book in one hand and reaches toward floating books with the other.

stills.title: Armored Figure on Anvil
stills.description: A figure in full metal armor sits on a large cracked anvil with glowing orange lines, arms crossed over its chest. The figure has a glowing purple crystal for a head emitting smoke and a white rose hovers above it inside a large circular metal ring covered in painted marks and runes, all set against a swirling dark purple background with floating objects and green aurora lights at the bottom.

stills.title: Mystic Weaving Loom
stills.description: A person's hand holds a shuttle and works on a wooden weaving loom that sits on an unrolled scroll. Golden liquid drips from the top scroll down into a pool of water below while glowing geometric shapes float in the dark background.

stills.title: Mysterious Cosmic Altar
stills.description: A person's hand with a ring rests on a dark floating table covered in circles and painted marks. Above the table a glowing heart shape made of lines floats in the air with light and smoke rising from the center while white moths fly nearby.

stills.title: Woman with Armillary Sphere
stills.description: A woman with her hair in a bun sits on a stool facing an armillary sphere and an open book. Her right hand touches the book which has a red wax seal and dripping red liquid while torn pages with marks lie on the floor; she holds a tool in her left hand. The setting is inside a room with a large circular stained glass window showing stars and patterns against a twilight sky, surrounded by swirling colorful clouds. The colors are deep blues, golds, reds, and purples.

stills.title: Mystic Crystal on Chalkboard
stills.description: A large glowing crystal ball rests on a black chalkboard covered in colorful paint marks and writing. A lit candle, brass compass, scattered papers, and lavender sprigs sit around the board against a dark blue textured wall.

stills.title: Spellforge Muse
stills.description: A painting shows a female figure with a mask-like face covered in symbols standing beside a large blackboard filled with painted marks and writing. Her hands touch a glowing quill that drips golden liquid while colorful threads flow from her head and body into the dark background filled with floating torn papers bearing painted marks.

stills.title: Girl with Scroll Machine
stills.description: A girl with a long braid stands with her back to the viewer in a room covered in paint marks and writing. Her left hand touches a large mechanical wheel device that holds a long curling scroll filled with writing while her right hand holds an abacus.

stills.title: Mysterious Hands at Table
stills.description: A person sees three colored hands reaching over a wooden table covered in papers with painted marks and runes. The blue hand from the top left holds a torn paper, the purple hand at bottom holds a drawing compass, and the golden hand on the right holds a coin over another paper, all around a glowing glass orb with a black rose inside.

stills.title: Colorful Paint Splatter
stills.description: The picture shows an abstract composition of vibrant paint splashes and drips on a white background. Bright bursts of yellow, green, orange, blue, and purple form flowing shapes with thick drips running downward across the surface.

stills.title: Abstract Paint Splatter
stills.description: The picture shows an abstract composition of colorful paint splatters, drips, and blended shapes on a white background. Bright yellow, green, orange, and blue paints form organic blobs, circular forms, and vertical drips that spread across the center and edges.

stills.title: Colorful Abstract Menu
stills.description: A person sees a bright abstract painting with a large white menu overlay that has three horizontal bars and three colored circles. The background shows rounded plant shapes, a yellow hat on the ground, and many colorful orbs in a vibrant setting.

stills.title: Abstract Bottle Painting
stills.description: A person sees an abstract painting of a pink bottle standing upright in the center with a white cork in its top. The bottle has various painted marks in blue white and black with a pink square near its base and is surrounded by large areas of pink orange and blue paint with visible brush strokes and drips.

stills.title: Wanderer in Pink Desert
stills.description: A person in dark clothes stands on a sand dune holding a long staff while looking into the distance. The hands hold the staff and the setting is a vast desert with a trail of rocks and footprints leading to the figure under a solid pink sky.

stills.title: Knight Facing Dragon
stills.description: A knight in full armor with a red cape stands on rocky ground holding a sword pointed forward. In the sky above looms a large brown dragon looking down at the knight.

stills.title: Woman with Red Hair
stills.description: A woman with fair skin and bright wavy red hair looks directly at the viewer. She wears a low-cut light blue dress with gold patterns and lace trim, long dangling earrings, and has faint gold star marks painted on her chest and neck.

stills.title: Woman with Orange Hair
stills.description: A woman with long flowing orange hair looks down and to the side with a neutral expression.
